name: StreamBudget
description: Budget. Streams a token: the available amount grows each epoch, capped by what the DAO holds. Nothing accrues until the first checkpoint: the install proposal starts the stream by calling writeCheckpoint() after applying the installation. Commits a checkpoint after each flow through the DAO: it requires CHECKPOINT_PERMISSION_ID for the DAO, which the setup grants. setAmountPerEpoch, setMaxBudget and setEpochInterval need SET_SETTINGS_PERMISSION_ID.

settings.name: token
settings.description: The token streamed: an ERC20 (use WETH for ether). Native ETH isn't supported.

settings.name: amountPerEpoch
settings.description: How much the available amount grows per epoch. At most 2^128 - 1.

settings.name: maxBudget
settings.description: Maximum available amount at any time. 0 for no cap.
